pins.title: Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: You can find a Smithing Stone 1 on a dead body near the flooded gravestones in Summonwater Village.

pins.title: Smithing Stone 1 & 2
pins.description: Southeast of the Warmaster's Shack Site of Grace, you can find plenty of giant trolls roaming around. If you let one of them destroy the statue in the area, you can obtain plenty of Smithing Stones 1 and Smithing Stones 2.

pins.title: Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: You can find a Smithing Stone 2 on a ledge where you can find some bears and wolves fighting northwest of the Third Church of Marika Site of Grace.

pins.title: Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: You can find a total of five Smithing Stone 2 inside the Stormveil Castle after defeating Margit, the Fell Omen.

pins.title: Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Enter the Siofra River Well from the Limgrave side. Find the corpse near the area with the multiple skeletons with spears to obtain a Smithing Stone 2.

pins.title: Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: You can farm Smithing Stone 3 from the Flaming Chariot east of Fort Gael North Site of Grace.

pins.title: Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: You can farm a total of nine Smithing Stone 4 in the Ruin-Strewn Precipce north of Liurnia of the Lakes.

pins.title: Divine Tower of Limgrave
pins.description: You can restore Godrick's Great Rune at the top of the tower.

pins.title: Divine Tower of Caelid
pins.description: You can restore Radahn's Great Rune at the top of the tower.

pins.title: Divine Tower of West Atlus
pins.description: You can restore Rykard's Great Rune at the top of the tower.

pins.title: Divine Tower of Liurnia
pins.description: You can obtain the Cursemark of Death at the top of the tower.

pins.title: Divine Tower of East Atlus
pins.description: You can restore Morgott's Great Rune at the top of the tower.

pins.title: Isolated Divine Tower
pins.description: You can restore Malenia's Great Rune at the top of the tower.

pins.title: Bravo!
pins.description: Interact with the message near White Mask Varre after defeating a demigod.

pins.title: Finger Snap
pins.description: Acquired from Merchant Kale after talking to him about the howling at Mistwood.

pins.title: Strength
pins.description: Found on the edge of the cave after defeating the Soldier of Godrick Boss.

pins.title: Crossed Legs
pins.description: Obtained on top of the ruins south of Stormhill Shack.

pins.title: Sitting Sideways
pins.description: Acquired from Roderika at Stormhill Shack.

pins.title: Triumphant Delight
pins.description: Help free Alexander from the ground south of Saintsbridge.

pins.title: Nod in Thought
pins.description: Acquired after meeting Sorceress Sellen.

pins.title: Grovel for Mercy
pins.description: Defeat Patches and wait for him to surrender to you in Murkwater Cave.

pins.title: Patches' Crouch
pins.description: Defeat Patches again in Murkwater Cave at the end of his questline.

pins.title: Extreme Repentance
pins.description: Spare Patches when he surrenders, then attack him to make him hostile. Let him damage you until he says "Grovel... and I'll forgive you" then use the Grovel For Mercy gesture.

pins.title: Calm Down
pins.description: Return to Patches in Murkwater Cave after opening the treasure chest that teleports you to Mistwood.

pins.title: Dozing Cross-legged
pins.description: On a dead body guarded by a warhawk at the castle rooftops near the Rampart Tower site of grace in Stormveil Castle.

pins.title: As you Wish
pins.description: Give Hyetta a Shabriri Grape at the Church of Irith.

pins.title: Erudition
pins.description: Acquired after giving Thops the Academy Glintstone key.

pins.title: Desperate Prayer
pins.description: Acquired from Gowry after purchasing Pest Threads and exhausting Dialogue.

pins.title: Heartening Cry
pins.description: Acquired from Jerren at Redmane Castle.

pins.title: Polite Bow
pins.description: Acquired after speaking with Finger Maiden Thorelina in Redmane Castle.

pins.title: Fire Spur Me
pins.description: Obtained at the outpost west of Liurnia Lake Shore.

pins.title: Spread Out
pins.description: Acquired after purchasing prawns from Blackguard Big Boggart at Boilprawn Shack.

pins.title: Balled Up
pins.description: Acquired from Renalla after rebirthing.

pins.title: Casual Greeting
pins.description: Acquired after summoning Great Horned Tragoth for the Magma Wyrm Makar fight.

pins.title: Casual Greeting
pins.description: Acquired after summoning Great Horned Tragoth for the Starscourge Radahn boss fight.

pins.title: My Thanks
pins.description: Defeat Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and find the gesture a the end of the hallway in Volcano Manor.

pins.title: Outer Order
pins.description: Talk to Melina at the Minor Erdtree Church at the Altus Plateau.

pins.title: Golden Order Totality
pins.description: Reward for helping Goldmask figure out the truth behind Radagon.

pins.title: By My Sword
pins.description: Can be found at Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Fortified Manor.

pins.title: My Lord
pins.description: Give Boc the Gold Sewing Needle at the East Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

pins.title: Hoslow's Oath
pins.description: Acquired after you invade Juno Hoslow at the Mountaintops of the Giants.

pins.title: Fancy Spin
pins.description: Summon the Spirit Jellyfish near the other jellyfish at the Stargazer's Ruins.

pins.title: Inner Order
pins.description: Acquired from D's brother after talking to him and giving him the Twinned Armor Set at Siofra Aqueduct.

pins.title: Dragonburnt Ruins Transporter Chest
pins.description: A trap chest that transports you to Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid (High-Level area). Fast travel through sites of grace is locked once transported.

pins.title: Third Church of Marika Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you to the Beastial Sanctum in Caelid.

pins.title: Tower of Return Transporter Chest
pins.description: A trap chest that transports you to the Divine Bridge in Altus Plataeu. Fast travel through sites of grace is locked once transported.

pins.title: Limgrave Tower Bridge Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you to the Divine Tower of Limgrave. The Divine Tower is only accessible after defeating Godrick the Grafted.

pins.title: Purified Ruins Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you to the South Raya Lucaria Gate in Liurnia.

pins.title: Laskyar Ruins Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you to the South Raya Lucaria Gate in Liurnia.

pins.title: South Raya Lucaria Gate Portal
pins.description: Academy gate that leads you to the Main Academy Gate of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia.

pins.title: Main Academy Gate Portal
pins.description: A gate hub in Raya Lucaria that can transport you to the South Raya Lucaria Gate or East Raya Lucaria Gate.

pins.title: East Raya Lucaria Gate Portal
pins.description: Academy gate that leads you to the Main Academy Gate of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia.

pins.title: Pavillon North of Academy Gate Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore, close to the Kingsrealm Ruins in Liurnia.

pins.title: Precipice of Anticipation
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Chapel of Anticipation (starting area). An Imbued Stonesword Key is required to activate the Waygate.

pins.title: Night Sky Unceasing
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to Nokron, Eternal City. An Imbued Stonesword Key is required to activate the Waygate.

pins.title: Crumbling Lands
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Crumbling Farum Azula. An Imbued Stonesword Key is required to activate the Waygate.

pins.title: Renna's Rise Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to Ainsel River Main. Progress in Ranni's questline is required to access the tower and Waygate.

pins.title: Raya Lucaria Iron Maiden
pins.description: An Iron Maiden that transports you under the Prison Town Church in Volcano Manor (High-Level area). Fast travel through sites of grace is locked once transported.

pins.title: Fort Gael Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you outside of Redmane Castle in Caelid.

pins.title: Redmane Castle Outskirts Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you inside Redmane Castle in Caelid, near the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace.

pins.title: Chamber Outside the Plaza Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you at the Impassable Greatbridge in Caelid.

pins.title: Impassable Greatbridge Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you inside Redmane Castle in Caelid, near the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace.

pins.title: Redmane Castle Plaza Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Wailing Dunes in Caelid. This is where you fight Starscourge Radahn.

pins.title: Lizard Throne Balcony Portal
pins.description: A Waygate in Volcano Manor that teleports you to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy's location.

pins.title: Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the other side of the broken greatbridge, right above the Road to Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace.

pins.title: Divine Bridge Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you to the Isolated Divine Tower. The Divine Tower is only accessible after defeating Malenia.

pins.title: Albinauric Rise Portal
pins.description: A Waygate thate teleports you near the Minor Erdtree in the Consecrated Snowfield.

pins.title: Bloody Waygate
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to Mohgwyn Palace.

pins.title: Ordina, Liturgical Town Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that leads to Miquella's Haligtree. You must solve the puzzle in Ordina, Liturgical Town to gain access to the Waygate.

pins.title: Worshipper's Woods Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Siofra River Bank Waygate.

pins.title: Siofra River Bank Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Worshipper's Woods Waygate.

pins.title: Collapsed Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you to the Siofra Aqueduct Cliffs.

pins.title: Siofra Hallowhorn Grounds Portal
pins.description: Horned Remains that teleports you to the Ancestor Spirit location when touched.

pins.title: Night's Sacred Ground Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that transports you to the Ancestral Woods in Nokron.

pins.title: Nokron Hallowhorn Grounds Portal
pins.description: Horned Remains that teleports you to the Regal Ancestor Spirit location when touched.

pins.title: Great Waterfall Basin Coffin
pins.description: A Coffin that teleports you to the the Great Waterfall Crest in the Deeproot Depths.

pins.title: The Nameless Eternal City Coffin
pins.description: A Coffin that transports you to Ainsel River Main.

pins.title: Prince of Death's Throne Portal
pins.description: A Waygate that teleports you in a small chapel between the Capital Rampart and East Capital Rampart Sites of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. This Waygate deactivates after you defeat Maliketh, the Black Blade.

pins.title: Grand Cloister Coffin
pins.description: A Coffin that transports you to the location of Astel, Naturalborn of the Void.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Academy Crystal Cave
pins.description: Head southeast from the Crystalline Woods Site of Grace to the base of the Academy of Raya Lucaria to reach this area. Grants access to the Academy Crystal Cave.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Auriza Hero's Grave
pins.description: Unlocks a room within the catacombs where you can obtain the Golden Epitaph.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Black Knife Catacombs
pins.description: Unlocks a room within the catacombs where you can obtain Rosus' Axe.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Cave of the Forlorn
pins.description: Found near the end of the frozen river to the east in the Consecrated Snowfield. Grants access to the Cave of Forlorn.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Cliffbottom Catacombs
pins.description: Unlocks a room within the catacombs containing the Nox Mirrorhelm.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Crumbling Farum Azula
pins.description: Unlocks a lift that takes you to the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace and a large optional area.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Deep Siofra Well
pins.description: Unlocks the Deep Siofra Well lift that takes you to area that leads to the Great-Jar.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree Base
pins.description: Unlocks a room with an altar containing Marika's Soreseal.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
pins.description: Unlocks a small dark room with a chest containing the Triple Rings of Light incantation.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Forsaken Ruins
pins.description: Unlocks a room that has a chest containing the Sword of St. Trina.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Gaol Cave
pins.description: Cross the small rotten lake west of the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace. Grants access to the Gaol Cave.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave Entrance
pins.description: Located beside the Site of Grace, this Imp Statue unlocks a room containing the Flame, Protect Me incantation.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
pins.description: Unlocks a room containing the Cranial Vessel Candlestand.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Golden Lineage Evergaol
pins.description: Grants access to the Golden Lineage Evergaol, where you can defeat Godefroy the Grafted for the Godfrey Icon talisman.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Lunar Estate Ruins
pins.description: Unlocks a room containing the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Nokron, Eternal City
pins.description: From the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace, enter the chapel to the east and climb the ladder at the end of the hall. Turn right as you approach the altar to reach this Imp Statue.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Nokstella, Eternal City
pins.description: Climb the stairs to the west of the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace. The Imp Statue is found to you left before you cross the bridge.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Old Altus Tunnel
pins.description: Grants access to the Old Altus Tunnel. Use the valley path north of the Altus Plateau Site of Grace to reach this area.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Sainted Hero's Grave Entrance
pins.description: Located beside the Site of Grace, this Imp Statue unlocks a room containing the Crimson Seed Talisman.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Sainted Hero's Grave
pins.description: Upon reaching the room with the falling blade traps, ride the first blade as it comes back up and jump to the platform to the left. This path will lead you to a large room where the Imp Statues, which unlocks a room containing the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Seethewater Cave
pins.description: A sealed cave below Mt. Gelmir's Minor Erdtree. Use the path west of Wyndham Ruins to reach this area.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Spiritcaller Cave
pins.description: Head south from the Freezing Lake Site of Grace to reach this locked cave on the lake's western shore.Grants access to the Spiritcaller Cave.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Stormveil Castle Armory
pins.description: From the Rampart Tower, take the lift downward and turn left towards the small courtyard. It unlocks a room where you can get the Misericorde and Hawk Crest Wooden Shield.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Stormveil Castle Cellar
pins.description: From the Liftside Chamber, head south and go down the cellar stairs. The unlocked room will have chests that contain the Godslayer's Seal and Godskin Prayerbook.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Stranded Graveyard
pins.description: Grants access to the Fringefolk Hero's Grave from within the Stranded Graveyard.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Summonwater Village
pins.description: Unlocks a room with a chest containing the Green Turtle Talisman.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Tombsward Catacomb
pins.description: Located inside the Tombsward Catacomb, this seal opens a room where you can grab the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9].

pins.title: Imp Statue - Unsightly Catacombs
pins.description: Found below the Perfumer's Ruins. Grants access to the Unsightly Catacombs.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Volcano Manor East
pins.description: From the Prison Town Church, head east until you reach the large room with the serpent wizard on the throne. Head west to reach the Imp Statue and unlock a room with the hanging cages. Turn right and fall to the platform below instead to reach the room with the Dagger Talisman.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Volcano Manor West
pins.description: From the Prison Town Church, head west to reach this Imp Statue that unlocks a room with the Crimson Amber Medallion +1 on the second floor.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Weeping Evergaol
pins.description: Grants access to the Weeping Evergaol, where you can defeat the Ancient Hero of Zamor for the Radagon's Scarseal talisman.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Wyndham Catacombs
pins.description: Unlocks a room containing the Lightning Scorpion Charm.

pins.title: Imp Statue - Wyndham Ruins
pins.description: Unlocks a room containing the Pearldrake Talisman +1.

pins.title: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood
pins.description: Found beside the Shack of the Lofty. Reach this area easily from the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace.

pins.title: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger
pins.description: Invades you inside the Second Church of Marika, while following Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline.

pins.title: Rileigh the Idle
pins.description: Found on the path to the Shaded Casle

pins.title: Inquisitor Ghiza
pins.description: Found on the second floor of Volcano Manor

pins.title: Tanith
pins.description: Can be found seated inside the Volcano Manor's main hall.

pins.title: Anastasia, Tarnished Eater
pins.description: Invades your world at the Smoldering Church in Caelid, Corpse-Stench Shack in Mt. Gelmir, and in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfields.

pins.title: Goldmask
pins.description: Can be found on a broken bridge to the west of Dominula, Windmill Village.

pins.title: Vargram the Raging Wolf
pins.description: The red invasion sign is found inside the Fortified Manor, to the west of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace

pins.title: Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm
pins.description: Found together with Vargram the Raging Wolf. The red invasion sign is found inside the Fortified Manor, to the west of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace

pins.title: Gurranq the Beast Clergyman
pins.description: Can be found at the Bestial Sanctum in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.

pins.title: Gowry
pins.description: Can be found in Gowry's Shack outside Sellia's southern gate.

pins.title: Millicent (Invader)
pins.description: Invades you at the center of the Swamp of Aeonia

pins.title: Millicent
pins.description: Found inside the Church of Plague in Caelid. Do note that you cannot advance her questline until you progress Gowry's first.

pins.title: Mimic Tear
pins.description: Can be found in Nokron, Eternal City

pins.title: Jerren
pins.description: Can be found inside Redmane Castle, in the wide courtyard where several NPCs gather for the Radahn Festival.

pins.title: Patches
pins.description: Players will first find Patches inside Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. You will first need to defeat the invader, Bloody Finger Nerijus. Patches will then move to Volcano Manor later on.

pins.title: Melina
pins.description: Appears and talks to you while you're resting at the third Site of Grace you've encountered.

pins.title: Irina
pins.description: Found by the side of the road leading down south to the Weeping Peninsula.

pins.title: Boc the Seamster
pins.description: Found close to the telescope. Boc is disguised as a bush. Roll into the bush to reveal him.

pins.title: Knight Bernahl
pins.description: Can be found inside the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill.

pins.title: Bloody Finger Nerijus
pins.description: Invades you when approaching Murkwater Cave

pins.title: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
pins.description: Under a collapsed arch near the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace.

pins.title: Edgar
pins.description: Edgar can be found at the highest rampart of Castle Morne. In order to get to him, players will have to get past multiple enemies. The nearest Site of Grace will be the Castle Morne Lift.

pins.title: Nepheli Loux
pins.description: In a small room with a dead knight, south of the Secluded Cell in Stormveil Castle.

pins.title: Alexander
pins.description: Found stuck in the ground in the open world, close to the Saintsbridge site of grace

pins.title: Roderika
pins.description: Roderika can be found inside Stormhill Shack in Limgrave. This area is easily accessed after acquiring Torrent from Melina, and running to the northwest from the Gatefront Site of Grace.

pins.title: Recusant Henricus
pins.description: Located outside the colosseum, northeast of Stormhill Shack.

pins.title: White Mask Varre
pins.description: Varre is first located just outside of the tutorial area when you first arrive at Limgrave.

pins.title: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
pins.description: Can be found in Mistwood Ruins. Use the Finger Snap gesture when you hear howling to make Blaidd come down.

pins.title: Merchant Kale
pins.description: Can be found inside the Church of Elleh.

pins.title: Sorceress Sellen
pins.description: Can be found in the Waypoint Ruins Cellar.

pins.title: Rogier
pins.description: Rogier can be found inside a small chapel in Stormveil Castle. Players can easily find him after unlocking the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in the castle.

pins.title: Renna
pins.description: Ranni the Witch's first appearance. She only appears after meeting Melina for the first time.

pins.title: Gatekeeper Gostoc
pins.description: Inside a room next to the main gate of Stormveil Castle.

pins.title: Kenneth Haight
pins.description: Found on top of a collapsed curved wall, east of the Artist's Shack.

pins.title: Old Knight Istvan
pins.description: After obtaining the letter from Volcano Manor requesting you to hunt down Istvan, start from the Stormhill Shack site of grace, head East and then North. There will be a red summon sign on the ground.

pins.title: Preceptor Miriam
pins.description: Found inside the Carian Study Hall on the eastern side of Liurnia.

pins.title: Hyetta
pins.description: Can be found next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace, right after exiting Stormveil Castle.

pins.title: Ranni the Witch
pins.description: First found in the Church of Elleh. You can meet her again at the top of Ranni's Rise.

pins.title: Albus
pins.description: Can be found in the Village of the Albinaurics, which can be accessed down at water-level in Liurnia.

pins.title: Latenna
pins.description: Can be found at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack. In order to access this area, players will need to clear the Lakeside Crystal Cave dungeon.

pins.title: Thops
pins.description: Found sitting on a bench in the Church of Irith.

pins.title: Blackguard Big Boggart
pins.description: Can be found at Boilprawn Shack.

pins.title: Rya
pins.description: Can be found taking refuge inside a pavilion, east of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace.

pins.title: Preceptor Seluvis
pins.description: Can first be found in Ranni's Rise as a spectral apparition. Players will first need to speak to Ranni the Witch first at the top of the tower to make him appear. Afterwards, you can find him in Seluvis' Rise.

pins.title: Miriel Pastor of Vows
pins.description: Can be found inside the Church of Vows.

pins.title: War Counselor Iji
pins.description: Found past an illusory wall that heads northward into Caria Manor

pins.title: Moongrum Carian Knight
pins.description: Found at the northeastern side of Raya Lucaria Academy, in a small courtyard with four statues.

pins.title: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
pins.description: Rennala becomes an NPC after defeating her in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library

pins.title: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin
pins.description: Part of Yura's questline. Find the red summon sign to invade and defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin

pins.title: Festering Fingerprint Vyke
pins.description: Invades you outside of the Church of Inhibition

pins.title: Great Horned Tragoth
pins.description: Part of the Volcano Manor Requests. Tragoth is found nside Magma Wyrm Makar's boss room at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

pins.title: Jar-Bairn
pins.description: Can be found in Jarburg.

pins.title: Pidia
pins.description: To reach this area, players will need to complete Caria Manor, head towards Seluvis' Rise, then fall down to this area.

pins.title: Bloody Finger Okina
pins.description: Invades you at the Church of Repose

pins.title: Shabriri
pins.description: Shabriri can be found as soon as players arrive at the Mountaintops of the Giants. He will be standing next to the Zamor Ruins site of grace

pins.title: Second Church of Marika
pins.description: You can find a Sacred Tear near the large sculpture inside the Second Church of Marika. The church can be found north of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace.

pins.title: Stormcaller Church's Sacred Tear
pins.description: A Sacred Tear can be found near the statue inside the Stormcaller Church.

pins.title: Church of the Plague's Sacred Tear
pins.description: You can reach the Church of the Plague by heading to the northern route or by breaking the seal in Selia, Town of Sorcery.

pins.title: Third Church of Marika's Sacred Tear
pins.description: Look for the soul next to the large sculpture surrounded by orange flowers to obtain the item.

pins.title: Church of Pilgrimage's Sacred Tear
pins.description: The path leading to this place is guarded with skeletal enemies that reanimate after you kill them.

pins.title: Fourth Church of Marika's Sacred Tear
pins.description: The church is guarded by two headless soldiers, but you can sneak around the church and have your way inside without alerting them.

pins.title: Callu Baptismal Church's Sacred Tear
pins.description: It's recommended that you rest at the Ailing Village Outskirts Site of Grace located directly north of the church before picking up the item as there are several burning rats guarding the place.

pins.title: Church of Irith's Sacred Tear
pins.description: Head northwest of the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace and find the ruins of a church. Head inside and find the Sacred Tear near the large sculpture.

pins.title: Bellum Church's Sacred Tear
pins.description: The Sacred Tear can be found below the large sculpture inside Bellum Church.

pins.title: Church of Inhibition's Sacred Tear
pins.description: The Church of Inhibition can be accessed by taking the northern route and making a detour to the Frenzied Flame Village. Crossing this area causes the Madness status effect so be sure to head to the church as quickly as possible.

pins.title: First Church of Marika's Sacred Tear
pins.description: The Sacred Tear can be found below the large sculpture inside the First Church of Marika.

pins.title: Church of Repose's Sacred Tear
pins.description: The Sacred Tear can be found below the large sculpture inside the Church of Repose.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found next to the Site of Grace under Miquella's Cross.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Reach this place by heading west from the Three-Path Cross site of grace. The fragment will be right next to another Miquella's Cross.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: From the Castle Front site of grace, head southeast to find the Pillar Path Cross site of grace. The fragment will be right next to a Miquella's Cross, with an NPC called Thiollier nearby.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found near a small statue of Marika next to the Castle Front site of grace.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment x2
pins.description: You can find two Scadutree Fragments inside the Church of Consolation by the statue of Marika. There will be a Black Knight guarding it.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found next to the Highroad Cross site of grace. After completing Castle Ensis, the Highroad Cross site of grace should be just after the exit

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: This fragment is found inside the Castle Ensis Legacy Dungeon, next to the Castle Ensis Checkpoint site of grace and a Miquella's Cross.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found next to the Moorth Ruins site of grace. After exiting Castle Ensis and reaching the Highroad Cross site of grace, head east to find Moorth Ruins

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found by the statue of Marika at the lake north of Moorth Ruins.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: In the camp north of the Highroad Cross site of grace.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: You can find two Scadutree Fragments in the Church of the Crusade by the big statue of Marika in the center of the church. Found northwest of Highroad Cross site of grace.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment x2
pins.description: Defeat the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: From the Recluses' River Upstream site of grace, head south and follow the rocks leading to the bottom by the river. After dropping down, follow the river north to find a coffin by the waterfall.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found next to the Storehouse, Fourth Floor site of grace.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
pins.description: Found inside Messmer's Tower after fighting a Fire Knight.

pins.title: Scadutree Fragment
