pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: In Volcano Manor, head southwest from the Temple of Eiglay site of grace. The corpse with the Somber Smithing Stone 5 is hanging on a ledge east from the cage elevator.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Altus Tunnel site of grace, follow the path to go further in the tunnel until you reach the second area with the stairs and wooden platforms.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: The Somber Smithing Stone 5 is located at the north west section at the bottom of the Sealed Tunnel. It is guarded by a strong Iron Maiden.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Erdtree Sanctuary site of grace, head west and then just before the west exit go to the room up north. There is a corpse there with three Somber Smithing Stones. This area can still be accessed even after setting the Erdtree on fire.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Shaded Castle Ramparts site of grace, head to the north west corner of the outer ring of the Shaded Castle. The corpse containing the Somber Smithing Stone 5 is beside a dead tree. Be careful because as you approach a strong enemy shall spawn from the location of the corpse.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Redmane Castle Plaza site of grace, head north until you see chairs. Just below the steps is a corpse with the Somber Smithing Stone 5.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Old Altus Tunnel site of grace, descend to the lowest area guarded by Leyndell Knights. Defeat the knights and head to the area behind the northern shack. Follow the path and shortly you will see a cavern. Search the south west section of the cavern walls to obtain the Somber Smithing Stone 5.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: Head north and just follow the path from the Rampart Side Path site of grace in the Altus Plateau region. Keep going until you reach the ruins. Head west inside the ruins until you see a corpse sitting on a chair near a cliff facing the Minor Erdtree. Loot the corpse to get the Somber Smiting Stone 5.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: You can find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 5 south of the bridge near Siofra River Bank at Nokron, Eternal City.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: There is a scarab surrounded by three enemies that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 5 at the southwestern area of the Bower of Bounty site of grace in the Altus Plateau.

pins.title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 3
pins.description: You can find the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 3 on a dead body near the entrance of the First Church of Marika. The church can be found east of the Whiteridge Road at the Mountaintops of the Giants.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained by killing the scarab north of the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found at the end of the tunnel after turning right past the first gate.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found near the flower enemies in Recluses' River. Drop down the ledges north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace to reach this area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found at the base of the tree south of the untouchable enemies between the Abyssal Woods and Divided Falls Site of Grace. Approach this location from the south.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found on the balcony ledge guarded by an Abductor Virgin.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab inside the pipe near the giant crawfish in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found at the bottom of the pipe area where the giant crawfish enemies are. You can jump from on top of one of the pipes to a lower one to reach the bottom area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained inside a giant skull on a small rocky outcropping.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab perched on top of the rightmost rock pillar.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab hanging on the tall tree near the ruins.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found on the ledge while being guarded by hand enemies.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Dropped by the two lion enemies inside Castle Sol.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained on the ledge under the Great Bridge. You can access this area by heading down to the plaza area populated by eagles and heading to one of the bridge's pillars.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained on the great bridge.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found on the ledge of one of the floating debris.

pins.title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 4
pins.description: Obtained near the Tempest-Facing Balcony Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found on a small ledge on the north western part of the map. Climb up the roots with the Basilisks and drop to the ledge to get access to the corpse.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained inside a ruined mausoleum on the north western part of the map. The door to the ruined mausoleum is on its western side.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained on a hidden ledge above the Runebear. You can access this location by carefully dropping down a hole on the top ledge north east of the Across the Roots Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found in a small cave guarded by a Runebear.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found inside this building.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Dropped by the Malformed Star in the northern Uhl Palace Ruins.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained from a chest in a room accessible through a window.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found on the edge of a cliff.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Obtained from a chest guarded by Silver Tears.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found on a small platform southwest of the Lake of Rot Shoreside Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 7
pins.description: Found within the ruins in the eastern wall of the Lake of Rot.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: From the Belurat, Tower Settlement site of grace, advance a bit toward the corridor where two enemies shoot at you with Spiral Incantations from atop a bridge. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 will be by a fountain being worshipped by a group of enemies.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: From the Castle Front site of grace before Castle Ensis, head north, move east from the giant, and get behind the building, where the Somber Smithing Stone 3 will be.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: Enter Temple Town Ruins through the small hole in the wall to the south. Once inside, head the the north part and turn west. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 will be in a small alley with a single crying enemy.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: Enter Taylew's Ruined Forge. Proceed through the area, go up the giant cylinder, turn right at the top, and continue on until you climb up a ladder with two red blob enemies that drop from the ceiling. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 should be right behind you, across a short gap.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: There is a scarab in the forest north of the Grand Lift of Dectus that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 3 upon defeat. Be careful of the hawk enemies that will swoop down once you approach.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: There is a Scarab under a large rock right outside the Carian Study Hall. Kill the Scarab to obtain the Somber Smithing Stone 3.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: Looted from a corpse on a cliffside beneath The Four Belfries with a view overlooking Testu's Rise. The fastest way here would be from the Sorcerer's Isle site of grace to the northeast.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 3 on a corpse sitting on a chair on the shoreline south of the East Raya Lucaria Gate site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 3 on a dead body sitting on a chair on the shoreline south of the East Raya Lucaria Gate site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: You can obtain up to four Somber Smithing Stone 3 in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: Head down the Ainsel River Well elevator from Liurnia. Keep on heading west till you reach the Ainsel River Downstream site of grace. Then, head west even further past giant ants till you reach a cliff overlooking the Lake of Rot. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 will be on a corpse to the side.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: From the Main Caria Manor Gate site of grace, head to the east wall, then north into a back alley. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 can be looted from a corpse.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: From the Manor Lower Level site of grace, head east along the elevated walkway to the end. Then jump down to a lower rampart. Head south, then west, past an Iron Maiden enemy, until you're on top of the Caria Manor main entrance. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 will be on a corpse hanging from the ledge.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: Upon entering the Academy of Raya Lucaria, head south to the Church of the Cuckoo. The Somber Smithing Stone 3 will be on a corpse behind the altar.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: From the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace, head east past the graveyard and past the large rotating wheel to an altar that is guarded by a powerful gravity-using enemy. Grab the Somber Smithing Stone 3 from the altar.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 3
pins.description: Purchase up to three from Iji for 4000 Runes each.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Prison Town Church site of grace, head west, across roofs and down to the center of the town with a burning pyre. The Scarab holding a Somber Smithing Stone 5 is nearby.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 5
pins.description: From the Temple of Eiglay site of grace, head up the elevator, east out to the balcony, jump down into the hardened lava, and continue on the path, past the slugs and past the iron maiden enemy to find a scarab with the Somber Smithing Stone 5.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast boss in Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Drop down the platforms where the snake statues are facing the lava lake and enter the room with the basilisks are.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: On the rooftop of one of the buildings outside the Guest Hall Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Drops from the Full-Grown Falling Star Beast boss in this crater.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: On a dead noble sitting on a chair guarded by a wolf on the cliff southeast of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: From the Old Altus site of grace, follow the path until you reach the wooden platforms of the main chamber. Climb the ladder you see up north from the platform and proceed until you enter a cavern with a shed. Squeeze through the small gap to reach this smithing stone.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: From the Old Altus Tunnel site of grace, reach the bottom section of the cave. This would be the area guarded by two Leyndell Knights and a Leyndell Soldier. Search the wall behind the shack to obtain the Somber Smithing Stone 6.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Behind the broken wall at the corner of this area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Behind a statue a misbegotten is praying to past the closed gate east of Leyndell.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: At the end of the corridor being guarded by an Abductor Virgin.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by the lion enemy beside the Perfumer.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab on the bridge.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab on the spiral staircase in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: On top of a wooden platform on one of the pipes in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by the spear-wielding Crucible Knight in the Siofra Aqueduct.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: On top of the highest ledge in Uhl Palace Ruins South. You can reach this area from the Ainsel River Main area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab hiding in the vegetation on the bridge.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab in the Lake of Rot.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Found in the lower section of the ant cave.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab on the ground.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Found inside the ruined tower.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab on top of the large branches.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Obtained beside the giant crawfish enemy at the base of one of the Ellac River waterfalls.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Found in front of the third golem you'll encounter in the Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Found on the Castle Ensis ramparts.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 6
pins.description: Found on top of the structure with the Page enemy. A ladder to the west of the structure can be climbed.

pins.title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 2
pins.description: You can get the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 2 as a reward for defeating the Crystalian boss duo at Altus Tunnel.

pins.title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5
pins.description: You can find the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 on a dead body inside the small church near the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 9 is dropped by the Troll Knight at the entrance of Castle Ensis.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 9 can be picked up from a corpse in the Specimen Storehouse after ascending the elevator from the Church District in Shadow Keep.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 9 can be acquired at the end of the bridge from the West Rampart site of grace in Shadow Keep that leads to the Viaduct Minor Tower in Rauh Ruins.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: From the Viaduct Minor Tower site of grace, head onward into the catacombs. Make two right turns to find an enemy high up on a large root who casts spiral incantations as you approach. The Somber Smithing Stone 9 will be right next to it.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 9 can be found right beside the Outer Wall site of grace upon reaching Enir-Ilim for the first time from Rauh Ruins, after defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: A Scarab can be found outside Taylew's Ruined Forge, on a pillar on the northeastern side of its entrance.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 9 on a body surrounded by a circle of chairs near the foot of the Divine Tower of Caelid east of the Dragonbarrow West site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 9 west of the Farum Greatbridge site of grace in the Caelid region.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 9 on a dead body on the area where you fight an Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 9 can be found in a cave north of the Palace Approach Ledge-Road site of grace and west of Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 9 on a corpse sitting on a chair on the bridge south of Stargazer Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants. This is the same bridge where Goldmask and Corhyn will appear as you progress their questline.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: There is a Somber Smithing Stone 9 on a dead body on top of the rock formation north of the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: There is an invisible scarab perched on top of the tallest rock pillar that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 9 upon defeat. You can find the area west of the Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield) and east of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 9 on a dead body sitting on a chair at the edge of a cliff east of the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 9 in Yelough Anix Tunnel. The stone is located on the wall on the right side of the room where an Onxy Lord spawns.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithng Stone 9 on a body guarded by three enemies at the bottom of the area in Crumbling Farum Azula. Start from the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and head down to the building with an elevator.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: Another Somber Smithing Stone 9 is on a corpse in the ruined section before the Dragon Temple Site of Grace. The corpse is on a ledge accessible by dropping down a hole next to a large leaning pillar. If coming from the Dragon Temple Site of Grace, simply turn south and carefully drop down the ruined section and follow the path to where the corpse is sitting.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: On a corpse located on the outside area of the Dragon Temple. Turn south from the Site of Grace and carefully drop to the ruined section and then drop further down to the lowest part of the Dragon Temple. Head inside the archway and turn right and into a large section filled with sarcophagi and several Banished Knights. Turn right into the outside area and grab the Stone from the corpse near the ledge.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: On a corpse leaning on one of the pillars in the upper balcony on the northern section of the Dragon Temple. You can access this by heading up the large spiral staircase and turning right into the area with the Imp Statue that unlocks access to Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace. The corpse is on the opposite side of the area leaning on the fallen pillar close to an Azula Beastman.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: Progress through Miquella's Haligtree until you reach the Haligtree Town Plaza site of grace. The Somber Smithing Stone 9 should be in a room just below the site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 9 on a corpse in a small room guarded by a Crystalian in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Access this area by dropping down to the pathway patrolled by a Putrid Tree Spirit, and heading to the north building. The room with the Crystalian is at the very end of this building.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 9
pins.description: On a corpse located in a secluded room in the lowest level of Elphael, guaraded by three Crystalians. You can access the lowest level of Elphael by backtracking from the Elphael Inner Wall Site of Grace and by using one of the flying buttresses to safely drop down on one of the lower roofs.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab on a tree trunk outisde the Divine Tower of Caelid.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Hidden below a secret passage

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: From the Underground Roadside, drop down the open drainage grate to the northeast and enter the pipe maze. Head straight without falling from the holes on the ground and turn right to the open gate. Continue heading straight until you reach a room with an omen guarding the top of the ladder. The Somber Smithing Stone is in the center of this room.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab nearnear the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found at the southern shoreline of the Freezing Lake beside a burrowed giant crawfish.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found at the ledge. You can reach this area by circling around the outskirts of Castle Sol to the north.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab in front of one of the frozen giant corspses on the pillar near the Foot of the Forge Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found at the ledge to the side of the Church of the Eclipse. You can get to this area by jumping on the wall outside the church near the ladder.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab on a Stone Pillar

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found on top of the top of the tall stone pillar. Use Torrent to double jump around the edges and reach this area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab on top of a broken pillar near Ordina, Liturgical Town.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: After dropping from the first hole on the floor in the Yelough Anix Tunnel, cross the ravine and this Somber Smithing Stone 8 will be on left side of the wall.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: In one of the corners of the room in the Yelough Anix Tunnel where the Alabaster Lord spawns.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: On the ledge in front of a winged misbegotten between the Lionine Misbegotten and the Haligtree Plaza Town Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Follow the path south of the Dragon Temple Lift across the floating ruins and once reaching the tower, this Somber Smithing Stone is found on the ledge to the left.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: From the Beside the Great Bridge Grace, head north and the balcony at the end will have this Somber Smithing Stone.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found on the northern edge of the Lake of Rot Shoreside site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found at the southeastern edge of the Lake of Rot.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Picked up at the room after climbing the ladder in the tunnel after opening the first gate.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab hidden in the tall grass between a pillar and a large debris.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab hanging from the pillar outside the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Dropped by a scarab by dropping down the Recluses' River from the Recluses' River Downstream Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found below the bridge before the lift going to the Specimen Storehouse. A nearby ladder can be climbed down to access this area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Found on one of the structural beams in the Specimen Storehouse Loft area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: Picked up in Taylew's Ruined Forge by jumping to the southern ledge from the pipe and heading down the stairs.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 8
pins.description: In a room full with Bloodfiends. Take the lift south of the Viaduct Minor Tower to reach this area.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Defeating the Ghostflame Dragon west of the Abandoned Ailing Village in Gravesite Plain will reward you with a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Defeating the Ghostflame Dragon south of Moorth Ruins in Scadu Altus will reward you with a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. You can also reach this area without having to pass through Castle Ensis by taking the hidden shortcut from the Fort of Reprimand.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Defeating the Ghostflame Dragon in the Cerulean Coast area of Southern Shore will reward you with a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. To get to this area, head south down the slope from the Castle Front site of grace near Castle Ensis until you reach a poison swamp, circle around down to Ellac River Cave, and once you're at Ellac River, head south all the way.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Defeating Ancient Dragon Senessax past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace in the Southern Shore region will reward you with a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. To get to Jagged Peak, you must pass through Dragon's Pit and defeat the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the dungeon.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Progress through the Jagged Peak area, past the Ancient Dragon Senessax boss fight until you reach the Jagged Peak Mountainside site of grace. From here, head southwest, jump up two spiritsprings to an area filled with small thunder blob enemies, which are guarding the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: From the Spiral Rise site of grace, progress west through the area until you reach the next spiral tower. Here, there will be an elevator that takes you down. The Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone should be at the end of the path, on a cut-off stairway overlooking the rest of Enir-Ilim.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: The final act of Latenna's questline will have you bring her to the Apostate Derelict which can be found to the northwest of the Consecrated Snowfield. Interact with the large Albinauric woman you find there to complete her questline. After exhausting Latenna's dialogue, she will reward you with a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: To complete Millicent's questline, players will need to take the Unalloyed Gold Needle to Malenia's flower in her boss area after defeating her. Use the Unalloyed Gold Needle on Malenia's flower to get both Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: You can obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone after defeating Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater at the Consecrated Snowfield. She can be found near the frozen river south of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: You can find a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in a chest in Mohgwyn Palace. The chest is located past the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace in front of a statue guarded by a large group of enemies.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: You can find a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in Crumbling Farum Azula. The item is in a small gazebo behind a large dragon south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace. The dragon will retreat from the area if you get close enough and hide behind some ruins for cover.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Start from the Prayer Room site of grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree and head north till you see a gazebo with a flying Scarab. Jump onto the buttress to reach the gazebo, run north past it, and jump onto another buttress to find the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in a chest in a room up ahead.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: From the Prayer Room site of grace, head north till you see the gazebo. Jump onto the buttress that leads eastward down to a lower section of Elphael. From here, head southward and pick up the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone that is being guarded by a large enemy.

pins.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
pins.description: Only available at the endgame, after Leyndell has transformed into the Ashen Capital. From the Leyndell, Ashen Capital site of grace, follow the dragon's wings. Climb the ladder at the end, follow the path, and descend down the stairs. Find the corpse in front of the gargoyle in the area to obtain the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: From the Castle Ensis Checkpoint site of grace, progress through the area until you reach a chapel guarded by Moonrithyll Carian Knight. Exit the other end of the chapel, past the noble casting sorceries at you and drop down the left side of the bridge. Climb up two sets of ladders to reach the roof of the chapel and find the Somber Smithing Stone 2 at the other end.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Head to Fog Rift Fort by falling down the cliffside from the Scadu Altus, West site of grace. The Somber Smithing Stone 2 should be on the path to the right when you encounter the Black Knight Garrew boss fight. You do not need to defeat the boss to obtain the smithing stone.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Head inside Ruined Forge Lava Intake, which is south from the Castle Front site of grace near Castle Ensis. Once inside, progress until you find the first golem in the area. The Somber Smithing Stone 2 should be on a corpse being sat on by a lava slime.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: From the West Rampart site of grace in Shadow Keep, head west on the bridge that leads to Rauh Ruins. Right before the Salza, Fire Knight Sage miniboss fight, the Somber Smithing Stone 2 will be on a corpse along the road.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Inside Gael Tunnel. You will not be able to obtain the Somber Smithing Stone 2 by warping directly inside Gael Tunnel. You must warp to a nearby site of grace, like the Rotview Balcony and enter Gael Tunnel. From here, drop down to the left of the wooden platform and enter a small alcove to find the Somber Smithing Stone 2.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Talking to Blaidd at Forlorn Hound Evergaol after summoning him for the Bloodhound Knight Darriwil boss fight will reward you with a Somber Smithing Stone 2.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Before the entrance to Castle Morne, head east to the shoreline, where there should be four red jellyfish guarding the Somber Smithing Stone 2 as well as an Arteria Leaf.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Two pieces of Somber Smithing Stone 2 can be looted off a body on a chair south of the entrance to Cliffbottom Catacombs in Liurnia.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: There is a Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 2 east of the Gate Town Bridge site of grace or northeast of Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes. Note that the scarab explodes once you fully deplete its health.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: A Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 2 can be found at the northern part of Academy Gate Town in Liurnia.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: You can find a Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 2 on the cliffs south of Rose Church in Liurnia.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: A Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 2 can be found southeast of the Foot of the Four Belfries site of grace or northwest of the Temple Quarter area.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Up to two Somber Smithing Stone 2 can be obtained from Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 2 can be looted from a body right beside the waygate northeast of the Siofra River Bank site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 2 can be found next to the waygate just south of the Worshippers' Woods site of grace in Siofra River.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 2
pins.description: Purchase an unlimited amount of Somber Smithing Stone 2 from Iji

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: The Somber Smithing Stone 1 is on a body hanging off a broken spiral staircase in a tower immediately to the west of the Stagefront site of grace. If coming from the entrance of Belurat, progress from the Small Private Altar until you reach the spiral tower with a Curseblade enemy patrolling up and down the stairs.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: From the Castle Front site of grace, cross the bridge into Castle Ensis and immediately head left. A Somber Smithing Stone 1 will be on a body hanging off the cliff.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: A Somber Smithing Stone 1 can be found on a body next to the Castle Ensis Checkpoint site of grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West site of grace, progress through the area, and head to the northernmost point of Rauh Ruins to an area with red trees and large flying insect enemies. The Somber Smithing Stone 1 will be on a body lying on a rock.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: Purchase an unlimited amount of Somber Smithing Stone 2 from Iji

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 1 on a corpse sitting on a chair west of Waypoint Ruins. Be sure to travel in the morning as the Night's Cavalry boss roams around the bridge leading to the area at night.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: Kill the explosive Scarab southwest of the Artist's Shack in Limgrave to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone 1.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: Progress through Limgrave Tunnels until you find an elevator going down. Ride the elevator but jump off onto a rocky platform behind you before it reaches the bottom. Continue further until you find a second elevator. Jump down the left side of the elevator and jump down the rocky platforms until you find a Somber Smithing Stone 1 on the last platform near the bottom.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: You can find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 1 on top of the ruined building west of Deathtouched Catacombs in Limgrave.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: There is a Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone 1 below the cliff south of the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave. To get to the Church of Dragon Communion, you must first pass through the Coastal Cave to the north.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: You can obtain up to three Somber Smithing Stone 1 inside of Morne Tunnel.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: Right before the Leonine Misbegotten boss room in Castle Morne, the Somber Smithing Stone 1 will be behind a building by the edge of the water.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: You obtain a Somber Smithing Stone 1 as a reward for defeating the Lion Guardian inside Stormveil Castle. You can easily reach this boss from either the Stormveil Main Gate or Limgrave Tower Bridge sites of grace. If you don't wish to run through the ballistas firing at you, you can approach from the Liftside Chamber site of grace and fight your way down.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: You can find a Somber Smithing Stone 1 on corpse sitting on a chair near a giant crab south of Rose Church.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 1
pins.description: Inside Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. Progress through the dungeon until you reach the area where marionettes drop down from the ceiling. Head into the area after that to find a Somber Smithing Stone 1 and other Smithing Stones bunched up together on the ground, and guarded by a large powerful miner.

pins.title: Star-Lined Sword
pins.description: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who is found at the end of a ravine in the northwest section of the Cerulean Coast.

pins.title: Rellana’s Twin Blades
pins.description: Obtained by beating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight at the end of Castle Ensis, then trading her Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Sword of Night
pins.description: Dropped by Jolan at the end of her questline after giving her an Iris of Occultation.

pins.title: Milady
pins.description: The Milady is found in a chest on top of a tower in the western area of Castle Ensis's entrance.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Three Somber Smithing Stones 4 can be obtained in Sellia Crystal Tunnel. One is obtained after climbing the first ladder, while the other two are obtained from the white ore deposits on the wall.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: On a corpse sitting on a chair at the cliff north of the Caelem Ruins Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab hanging on the giant tree root protruding from the ground.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Inside Gael Tunnel in the room with the giant Land Octopus.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: On a chair down the ledges east of the Fort Gael North Grace. You may use Torrent to double jump into in area from below.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Found in the eastern side of the Aeonia Swamp.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Dropped by a Lion Guardian.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab in front of the Caelid Catacombs entrance.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4 x2
pins.description: Dropped by the Lion Guardians at the etrance gate to Redmane Castle.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: From the Debate Parlor Grace, proceed to the academy rooftops area. Before jumping to the Church of Cuckoo rooftop, take the ladder down and the Somber Smithing 4 will be in a room below.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: On a noble sitting on a chair at the northern shore of the Liurnia Lake.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Dropped by a Scarab near the Ravine-Veiled Village Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: In a corner of the plaza in Nokron, Eternal City.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: From the Small Private Altar Site of Grace, jump on to the red rooftops to the south.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Beside the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Behind a Gravebird in the path between the Ellac River Cave and Ellac River Downstream Site of Grace.

pins.title: Somber Smithing Stone 4
pins.description: Found inside the tunnel that you can access beneath the nearby tree that is guarded by a Cemetery Shade.

pins.title: Dane’s Footwork
pins.description: Dropped by Dryleaf Dane at Enir-Ilim after defeating Leda and her allies.

pins.title: Backhand Blade
pins.description: Found beside a tomb northeast of the Scorched Ruins.

pins.title: Bloodhound’s Fang
pins.description: Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in Forlorn Hound Evergaol

pins.title: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
pins.description: Obtained at a forge in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

pins.title: Bloodfiend’s Arm
pins.description: Dropped by a specific Bloodfiend in Prospect Town.

pins.title: Blasphemous Blade
pins.description: Obtained by beating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy in Volcano Manor, then trading his Remembrance of the Blasphemous to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Dragon-Hunter’s Great Katana
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Ancient-Dragon Man at the Dragon Pit.

pins.title: Nagakiba
pins.description: Dropped by Yura after progressing his questline at the Second Church of Marika in Altus Plateau.

pins.title: Rakshasa’s Great Katana
pins.description: The Rakshasa's Great Katana is found in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. From the Recluses' River Downstream, head for the bottom of the river towards the east and you'll find the mausoleum by the edge of a waterfall.

pins.title: Obsidian Lamina
pins.description: Obtained from Ansbach's body after completing his quest.

pins.title: Moonveil
pins.description: Dropped by the Magma Wyrm at the end of Gael Tunnel in Caelid.

pins.title: Euporia
pins.description: Located in a hidden room in Enir-Ilim that requires platforming to reach.

pins.title: Shadow Sunflower Blossom
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Scadutree Avatar and trading its Remembrance to Enia.

pins.title: Eleonora’s Poleblade
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Eleonora Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika in Altus Plateau. However, do note that this invader will only spawn if you progressed Yura's questline.

pins.title: Fire Knight’s Greatsword
pins.description: Has a chance to drop from the Fire Knights with Greatswords in Shadow Keep. The easiest one to farm guards the lift in Shadow Keep to Specimen Storehouse.

pins.title: Falx
pins.description: Obtained by killing the Hornsent when he invades at the Church of the Bud. Falx can also be obtained if you helped Leda kill him in the Shadow Keep or killed the Hornsent at Enir-Ilim.

pins.title: Greatsword
pins.description: Obtained from a chest at the back of a carriage in Caelid northwest of the Caelem Ruins.

pins.title: Staff of the Great Beyond
pins.description: Obtained by beating Metyr, Mother of Fingers at the Finger Ruins of Miyr, then trading her Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Maternal Staff
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Ymir at the end of his questline.

pins.title: Giant-Crusher
pins.description: Obtained from a Carriage Chest to the south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace in the Altus Plateau. Upon reaching the area, you will be attacked by an Ulcerated Tree Spirit.

pins.title: Greatsword of Damnation
pins.description: Defeat Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame and exchange his Remembrance for this weapon with Enia, the Finger Reader.

pins.title: Rivers of Blood
pins.description: Defeat Bloody Finger Okina at the Church of Repose in Mountaintop of the Giants.

pins.title: Queelign’s Greatsword
pins.description: Give Queelign an Iris of Occultation at the end of his questline.

pins.title: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)
pins.description: Obtained by beating Promised Consort Radahn at the end of Enir-Ilim, then trading his Remembrance of a God and Lord to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)
pins.description: Obtained by beating Promised Consort Radahn at the end of Enir-Ilim, then trading his Remembrance of a God and Lord to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Dryleaf Arts
pins.description: Reward from Dryleaf Dane after beating him in a duel at Moorth Ruins.

pins.title: Bloody Helice
pins.description: Find the stairs in the Writheblood Ruins that lead to the Noble Sanguine boss fight. Defeat the boss and loot the chest in the back of the boss room.

pins.title: Ansbach’s Longbow
pins.description: Obtained either by assisting Ansbach against Leda or killing him in the Shadow Keep.

pins.title: Dark Moon Greatsword
pins.description: Obtained by completing Ranni's questline. Once you reach the Moonlight Altar, meet Ranni in the tunnels beneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes to receive the Dark Moon Greatsword.

pins.title: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
pins.description: Found in a cave by dropping onto a lower area from the northwest ledge of the Fissure Cross Site of Grace.

pins.title: Sword of Darkness
pins.description: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword into the Sword of Darkness here if you picked the sword up from Fog Rifts Catacombs.

pins.title: Sword of Night and Flame
pins.description: Obtained from a chest within the Caria Manor that can be reached from the Manor Lower Level site of grace.

pins.title: Dancing Blade of Ranah
pins.description: Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah boss in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

pins.title: Sword of Darkness
pins.description: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword into the Sword of Darkness here if you picked the sword up from either the Ruins of Unte or Rauh Ancient Ruins.

pins.title: Starscourge Greatsword
pins.description: Obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Starscourge with Enia.

pins.title: Leda’s Sword
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Needle Knight Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

pins.title: Black Steel Greathammer
pins.description: The Black Steel Greathammer is dropped by the Black Knight in the Church of Consolation.

pins.title: Staff of the Guilty
pins.description: Has a 2% base chance to drop from Guilty enemies that wield the flaming Staff of Guilty. One of the easiest places to farm is around Guardians' Garrison.

pins.title: Lightning Perfume Bottle
pins.description: The Lightning Perfume Bottle can be obtained from a submerged corpse located northeast of the Cerulean Coast Site of Grace. You can find the corpse on the small body of water past the river.

pins.title: Sword of Light
pins.description: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword into the Sword of Light here if you picked the sword up from Fog Rifts Catacombs or Ruins of Unte.

pins.title: Sword of Light
pins.description: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword into the Sword of Light here if you picked the sword up from the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

pins.title: Hand of Malenia
pins.description: Obtained by beating Malenia at the end of Miquella’s Haligtree, then trading her Remembrance of a Rot Goddess to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Mohgwyn’s Sacred Spear
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood and trading the Remembrance of the Blood Lord with Enia.

pins.title: Uchigatana
pins.description: Obtained from a hanging corpse in Deathtouched Catacombs. The platform where the weapon is can only be reached through a small doorway, which can be unlocked by pulling the same lever that opens the boss room.

pins.title: Flowerstone Gavel
pins.description: Obtained by completing the Dragon Communion Priestess' questline without giving her Thiollier's Concoction.

pins.title: Reduvia
pins.description: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus in front of Murkwater Cave.

pins.title: Sacred Relic Sword
pins.description: Obtained by beating the Elden Beast at the Erdtree (accessed via Leyndell, Ashen Capital), then trading the Elden Remembrance to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Carian Regal Scepter
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon and trading the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen with Enia.

pins.title: Poleblade of the Bud
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud and trading the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud with Enia.

pins.title: Dragon King’s Cragblade
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Dragonlord Placidusax and trading the Remembrance of the Dragonlord with Enia.

pins.title: Spear of the Impaler
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Messmer the Impaler and trading the Remembrance of the Impaler with Enia.

pins.title: Freyja’s Greatsword
pins.description: Can be looted from Freyja's body after defeating Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim. If Freya doesn't spawn during this fight, she and her greatsword will appear at either the Storehouse, Seventh Floor in Shadow Keep, or back at the Three-Path Cross in Gravesite Plain.

pins.title: Freyja’s Greatsword
pins.description: Can be picked up next to the Three-Path Cross if you didn't progress Freyja's questline at all. The weapon will appear after defeating Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

pins.title: Freyja’s Greatsword
pins.description: Can be picked up from Freyja's usual spot on the Storehouse, Seventh Floor if you didn't give her the Letter to Freyja quest item from Ansbach. The weapon will appear after defeating Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

pins.title: Godslayer’s Greatsword
pins.description: Obtained from a chest behind a Godskin Apostle in the basement of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

pins.title: Bloodfiend’s Sacred Spear
pins.description: Dropped by one of the Bloodfiends wielding it in a pond north of Ancient Ruins Base.

pins.title: Bolt of Gransax
pins.description: Found on the giant spear near the center of Leyndell, Royal Capital. You will be locked out of this weapon after Leyndell turns into its ashen state.

pins.title: Beast Claws
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Logur the Beast Claw.

pins.title: Black Steel Greatshield
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Black Knight Garrew.

pins.title: Curseblade’s Cirque
pins.description: Dropped by Masked Curseblades. One of the easiest places to farm this weapon is from the Masked Curseblade near the Stagefront site of grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement.

pins.title: Morgott’s Curved Sword
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Morgott, the Omen King and trading the Remembrance of the Omen King with Enia.

pins.title: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
pins.description: Found on a corpse in the north room of the Abandoned Church.

pins.title: Thiollier’s Hidden Needle
pins.description: Looted from Thiollier's corpse after you defeat Prime Consort Radahn at the Divine Gate of Enir-Ilim. Thiollier's corpse only appears if you finish his questline and have his gold summon sign appear outside the boss room.

pins.title: Magma Blade
pins.description: Has a 1% base drop chance from Gelmir Man-Serpents that wield the weapon in Volcano Manor. One of the easiest areas to farm this weapon is near the lift north of Temple of Eiglay.

pins.title: Bastard’s Stars
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and trading the Remembrance of the Naturalborn with Enia.

pins.title: Winged Greathorn
pins.description: Obtained by defeating the Regal Ancestor Spirit and trading the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor with Enia.

pins.title: Lamenting Visage
pins.description: Found on a corpse inside a room hidden by an illusory wall in Lamenter's Gaol. The said room can only be unlocked using the Gaol Lower Level Key.

pins.title: Ordovis’s Greatsword
pins.description: Obtained from defeating the Crucible Knight Duo (Ordovis) at Auriza Hero's Grave.

pins.title: Black Steel Twinblade
pins.description: Dropped by the Black Knight in an encampment north of the Church of the Crusade.

pins.title: Greatsword of Solitude
pins.description: Dropped by the Blackgaol Knight in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

pins.title: Maliketh’s Black Blade
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade and trading the Remembrance of the Black Blade with Enia.

pins.title: Death Knight’s Twin Axes
pins.description: Dropped by the Death Knight at the end of Fog Rift Catacombs.

pins.title: Death Knight’s Longhaft Axe
pins.description: Dropped by the Death Knight at the end of Scorpion River Catacombs.

pins.title: Black Knife
pins.description: Dropped by the Black Knife Assassin at the entrance of the Sainted Hero’s Grave.

pins.title: Albinauric Staff
pins.description: Found in a room with an Omenkiller within the Prison Town area of Volcano Manor.

pins.title: Death’s Poker
pins.description: Defeat the Death Rite Bird west of the South Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace (only appears at night).

pins.title: Firespark Perfume Bottle
pins.description: Looted from a chest found in a small camp to the south of the Castle Front site of grace (near the entrance to Castle Ensis). It will be guarded by 3 Perfumer enemies.

pins.title: Fire Knight’s Shortsword
pins.description: Has a chance to drop from Fire Knights wielding Shortswords. One such Fire Knight can easily be farmed near the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace.

pins.title: Prelate’s Inferno Crozier
pins.description: Guaranteed drop from the Fire Prelate guarding Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir.

pins.title: Ghiza’s Wheel
pins.description: Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza after he invades you in the floor above the Volcano Manor site of grace in Mt. Gelmir.

pins.title: Serpent Flail
pins.description: Looted from a chest in Fog Rift Fort - a location near the Scadu Altus, West site of grace. The chest is located at the ground floor of the fort guarded by multiple Messmer Soldiers.

pins.title: Great Katana
pins.description: Found on a corpse next to a sleeping Ghostflame Dragon in a lake west of the Abandoned Ailing Village in Gravesite Plain.

pins.title: Gazing Finger
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Metyr, Mother of Fingers and trading the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Enia. Metyr is a hidden boss that can only be reached by following Ymir's questline and ringing the bell in Finger Ruins of Miyr.

pins.title: Dragon Communion Seal
pins.description: Dropped by a Banished Knight deep within the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave.

pins.title: Great Stars
pins.description: Looted from a chest on a carriage being pulled along by two Trolls and an escort of Leyndell Soldiers. The carriage can be found making its way along the Road of Iniquity in the Altus Plateau.

pins.title: Great Stars
pins.description: Dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw after you invade his world at the Writheblood Ruins in Altus Plateau. Look for his red invasion sign in the eastern building of the ruins.

pins.title: Verdigris Greatshield
pins.description: Looted from Moore's corpse at the battle against Leda in Enir-Ilim. Moore joins the Enir-Ilim battle if you tell him to "put it behind you" as part of his questline.

pins.title: Sword Lance
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Commander Gaius and trading the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Enia.

pins.title: Verdigris Greatshield
pins.description: Found on Moore's corpse beside a Forager Brood if you tell Moore to "remain sad forever" as part of his questline.

pins.title: Axe of Godrick
pins.description: Obtained by trading in the Remembrance of the Grafted to Enia at the Roundtable Hold. The remembrance is dropped by Godrick the Grafted - the final boss of the Stormveil Castle Legacy Dungeon.

pins.title: Antspur Rapier
pins.description: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan after you defeat them. Approaching the field with broken statues will aggro Maleigh Marais as well as a Guardian Golem.

pins.title: Putrescence Cleaver
pins.description: Obtained by defeating the Putrescent Knight and trading the Remembrance of Putrescence with Enia.

pins.title: Grave Scythe
pins.description: Has a 2% base drop chance from skeletons that wield the Grave Scythe. This graveyard west of the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace is the most efficient farming location for Grave Scythes.

pins.title: Dryleaf Seal
pins.description: Found on a platform south of a small graveyard located northeast of Recluses' River Downstream.

pins.title: Claws of Night
pins.description: Dropped by Swordhand of Night Anna in the Finger Ruins of Miyr. This area is unlocked by progressing Ymir's questline after ringing the bells of the two other Finger Ruins of Rhia and Dheo. Use the switch on Ymir's throne and go down the ladder to reach the area.

pins.title: Grafted Dragon
pins.description: Obtained by defeating Godrick the Grafted and trading the Remembrance of the Grafted with Enia.

pins.title: Barbed Staff-Spear
pins.description: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor at the Forsaken Graveyard (Abyssal Woods). This area is accessed at the end of the Darklight Catacombs.

pins.title: Spiraltree Seal
pins.description: Found southwest of the Northern Nameless Mausoleum after solving the Sacred Painting puzzle.

pins.title: Stone-Sheathed Sword
pins.description: Found on an altar inside the Fog Rift Catacombs. If you get this weapon from this altar first, other related altars will convert the weapon to either the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness.

pins.title: Stone-Sheathed Sword
pins.description: Found on an altar inside the Ruins of Unte. Throw a Hefty Furnace Pot on top of the blocking Furnace Golem to awaken it and unlock the entrance to the ruins. If you get this weapon from this altar first, other related altars will convert the weapon to either the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness.

pins.title: Stone-Sheathed Sword
pins.description: Found on an altar on top of some columns at the Rauh Ancient Ruins. Cross the invisible bridge to get to the altar. If you get this weapon from this altar first, other related altars will convert the weapon to either the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness.

pins.title: Red Bear’s Claw
pins.description: Obtained by defeating the Red Bear in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

pins.title: Ruins Greatsword
pins.description: Dropped by the Leonine Misbegotten and Crucible Knight duo in Redmane Castle. The castle must not be in its Radahn Festival state for the bosses to appear.

pins.title: Marika’s Hammer
pins.description: Obtained by beating the Elden Beast at the Erdtree (accessed via Leyndell, Ashen Capital), then trading the Elden Remembrance to Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

pins.title: Horned Warrior’s Greatsword
pins.description: Dropped by the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior just before the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom site of grace in Enir-Ilim.

pins.title: Carian Thrusting Shield
pins.description: Looted from a corpse to the west of the Storehouse, Back Section site of grace. It will be guarded by a Fire Knight and 3 Shadowy Mages.

pins.title: Smithscript Cirque
pins.description: Looted from a corpse inside the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The corpse is found in a circular room with a waterfall and some sleeping enemies.

pins.title: Chilling Perfume Bottle
pins.description: Found on a corpse inside a cell in Lamenter's Gaol. You will need the Gaol Upper Level Key to unlock the section where this weapon is.

pins.title: Dueling Shield
pins.description: Found on a corpse at the Third Floor of the Specimen Storehouse in Shadow Keep.

pins.title: Devonia’s Hammer
pins.description: Dropped by Crucible Knight Devonia near the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace. This enemy can be found standing on a rock in the middle of a grove.

pins.title: Spirit Sword
pins.description: Found in a graveyard northeast of the Cerulean Coast West site of a grace.

pins.title: Anvil Hammer
pins.description: Looted from the altar at the end of the Ruined Forge Lava Intake in Gravesite Plain (south of Castle Ensis).

pins.title: Madding Hand
pins.description: Dropped by the hostile NPC Madding Hand in the Abyssal Woods. He can be found along the path south of the Woodland Trail Site of Grace.

pins.title: Nanaya’s Torch
